rationale.oversight-theater: Names Rubber-Stamp Risk: review without authority/time/info to change outcomes
rationale.hitl-workflow: Override + execution-boundary control = human's enforceable control surface
rationale.risk-routing: Escalate control: risk-based triggers, tiered routing to reviewers
rationale.oversight-explanation: Explain control: decision-ready reasons, uncertainty signals at decision point
rationale.org-governance: Operating model, roles, audit logs, KPIs, governance cadence
rationale.regulatory-compliance: Maps to EU AI Act, ISO 42001, NIST AI RMF, GDPR
rationale.framework: Reusable intervention reference architecture for decision pipelines
rationale.design-only: Controls/KPIs specified in buildable detail, never evaluated
rationale.metrics: Defines override/escalation/harm KPIs as deliverable; measurand=over-reliance
rationale.risk-overreliance: Focal treatment of rubber-stamping/over-trust in model outputs
rationale.general-ai: Object is general ML decisions (credit/hiring/triage), not coding
